name: io.github.ctxstore-ai/ctxstore-mcp
description: Persistent memory for AI agents. Hosted MCP server at https://mcp.ctxstore.ai/mcp (HTTP) or this stdio edition for clients without HTTP support. Sign in with the setup_account tool; a six-digit email code, no password.

TENANT_API_KEY.description: Your ctxstore.ai API key (emk_...). Leave unset to start keyless and sign in with setup_account.

tools.name: setup_account
tools.description: Sign up or in with a six-digit email code; the key is kept for the session.

tools.name: load_context
tools.description: Read the compiled memory for this account: identity, conventions, current state, the last closing note.

tools.name: search_facts
tools.description: Semantic search over stored facts, decisions and learnings.

tools.name: search_context
tools.description: Semantic search over ingested conversations and sessions.

tools.name: store_fact
tools.description: Store a fact under a stable key; re-storing the key supersedes the old version.

tools.name: store_session_summary
tools.description: Close a session with a summary the next session reads first.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Counts and plan usage for this account.
